name: The Magnificent Seven Portfolio (+10%)
description:
The Magnificent Seven, the companies behind most of the US market's growth this past decade, in a single portfolio.

Unlike your normal Mag7 ETF, this one earns an additional 10% on top. The 10% accrues automatically to your portfolio.

name: Nancy Pelosi Tracker
description: Nancy Pelosi, the former Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, is among the most closely watched names in the market, with the trades disclosed in her congressional filings drawing intense public attention for their strong reported performance. The activity is concentrated in large-cap technology and AI companies, and has become a widely followed signal among retail investors who track congressional disclosures. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the positions disclosed in Nancy Pelosi's congressional financial filings, with options converted into their underlying stock equivalents.

name: Warren Buffett Tracker
description: Warren Buffett built Berkshire Hathaway into one of the most successful investment companies in history, turning a struggling textile maker into a conglomerate worth hundreds of billions through a patient, value-focused approach to owning great businesses. His portfolio is among the most closely watched in the world, known for concentrated, long-term bets on durable, cash-generating companies. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the equity positions disclosed by Berkshire Hathaway in its public SEC filings.

name: Leopold Aschenbrenner Tracker
description: Leopold Aschenbrenner is a former OpenAI researcher who went viral in 2024 with his essay series Situational Awareness, arguing that artificial general intelligence is arriving sooner than almost anyone expects and that the economic consequences will be staggering. He went on to launch Situational Awareness LP, an investment fund built around that idea. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the long positions disclosed by Situational Awareness LP in public SEC filings.

name: Cathie Wood Tracker
description: Cathie Wood is the founder and chief investment officer of ARK Invest, and one of the most closely followed investors in the world, known for high-conviction bets on disruptive innovation across artificial intelligence, crypto, robotics, and genomics. Her flagship ARK Innovation strategy is recognised for concentrated positions in fast-growing technology companies positioned to benefit from major technological shifts. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the equity positions disclosed in ARK Invest's publicly published holdings.

name: Hard Money
description: Precious metals and bitcoin have historically held their value when currencies weaken and inflation runs high. This portfolio holds physical gold and silver alongside smaller allocations to platinum and bitcoin, combining the oldest stores of value with the newest.

name: Quantum
description: Quantum computing aims to solve problems that classical machines cannot, and the market is only beginning to price in its long-term potential. This portfolio pairs the large technology companies funding quantum research with the smaller pure-play developers building the hardware.

name: Energy Infrastructure
description: Electricity demand is rising sharply as AI data centers, electric vehicles, and reshored manufacturing all draw more power from the grid. This portfolio holds the utilities, equipment manufacturers, and storage providers building the capacity to meet it.

name: Pure Silicon
description: Semiconductors are the foundational hardware behind every device, model, and machine, and demand continues to climb as computing spreads into more of the economy. This portfolio concentrates on the chip industry itself: the designers, the memory makers, the foundries that manufacture wafers, and the equipment companies that supply the production lines.

name: Neo Finance
description: Financial services are shifting away from traditional banks toward digital platforms, payment networks, and crypto-native businesses. This portfolio combines the established card networks that process most global transactions with the trading apps, neobanks, and stablecoin issuers competing to replace them.

name: The Compute Grab
description: Cheap power and available land have become the scarcest resources of the AI era, and a wave of operators are racing to convert both into data center capacity. This portfolio holds the infrastructure companies, cloud providers, and former crypto miners pivoting to high-performance computing, alongside the power producers supplying them.

name: AI Full Stack
description: The artificial intelligence build-out runs across several industries at once: the chips that train models, the servers and networking that run them, the cloud platforms that rent out capacity, and the power generation feeding the data centers. This portfolio holds a position in every layer rather than concentrating on a single winner.

name: The Arsenal
description: Defense budgets are rising worldwide, and the nature of warfare is shifting toward software, drones, and autonomous systems. This portfolio pairs the established defense primes with the newer technology companies reshaping the battlefield.

name: Digital Fortress
description: Every new connected device and AI system adds another target to defend, and cybersecurity spending continues to climb as a result. This portfolio holds the platforms and infrastructure protecting the digital world, from endpoint and network security to cloud and identity.

name: Black Gold
description: Oil remains central to the global economy, and the companies that produce, refine, and transport it generate some of the largest cash flows in the market. This portfolio holds the integrated majors, independent producers, and oilfield service providers that benefit when energy prices rise.

name: Escape Velocity
description: Space has shifted from a government program to a genuine commercial industry, with launch, satellites, and orbital services now generating real revenue. This portfolio holds the rocket builders, satellite operators, and space infrastructure companies developing the economy above the atmosphere.

name: Mine The Future
description: Robots, chips, electric vehicles, and weapons all begin as raw materials pulled from the ground. This portfolio holds the miners and processors supplying the critical metals and minerals behind the industrial economy, including rare earths, copper, lithium, and uranium.

name: Going Nuclear
description: Nuclear power is returning to favor after decades on the sidelines, driven by the need for constant, carbon-free electricity to run AI data centers. This portfolio combines the utilities operating today's reactors with the small modular reactor developers and uranium miners positioned for the next wave.

name: Consumer Brands
description: Consumer brands are the companies people interact with daily through what they stream, eat, wear, and buy on repeat. This portfolio holds established businesses with strong pricing power, loyal customers, and long records of steady growth.

name: The Healthcare Trade
description: A new class of blockbuster drugs is reshaping healthcare and creating some of the most valuable companies in medicine. This portfolio anchors on the leaders behind that breakthrough and broadens into large pharmaceutical makers, medical device companies, and biotech.

name: Road Warriors
description: The automobile is being reinvented twice over, first as electric and then as autonomous. This portfolio holds the manufacturers, ride-hailing platforms, and self-driving software companies competing to define how people and goods move next.

name: Bitwise Mag7x
description:
The Mag7x is composed of the Mag7 plus SpaceX. The model portfolio is designed by Bitwise and powered by Coinbase tokenized equities.

 This portfolio is incentivized with an additional 10% return. Rewards are paid in dollars that automatically accrue to your portfolio.

This strategy has a 0.20% fee.

name: Base Ecosystem ETF
description:
This portfolio is supported by Base. Rewards automatically compound into your balance at least every 24 hours. 

It maintains equal allocation across ETH, BTC, SOL, AERO, VIRTUAL and MORPHO, diversified exposure across blue-chips, DeFi and AI sectors.

A minimum balance of $100 is required to earn rewards.

name: 50/50 BTC and ETH
description: Holds 50% BTC and 50% Ethereum.

name: Gold
description: Two tokenized golds.

name: The Big Five
description: An equal weighted portfolio of BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE.
